name: Kinder Morgan Interstate Colorado Lateral

values.OtherEnglishNames: Colorado Lateral Expansion Project; KM Colorado Lateral Project
values.Owner: Kinder Morgan Interstate Gas Transmission LLC

researcher_notes: A Federal Register notice from January 18, 2008 (FERC environmental assessment, docket CP07-430) says Kinder Morgan Interstate Gas Transmission proposed about 41.4 miles of 12 inch pipeline in Weld County, Colorado, adding 57 million cubic feet per day from the Cheyenne Hub to the Greeley market, plus 10.8 miles of lateral distribution lines. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 566 (KM Colorado Lateral Project), lists it as Completed with an in service date of December 2008, 41.4 miles, 12 inch, docket CP07-430. EIA states 74 million cubic feet per day; the FERC notice states 57. The notice figure is staged. FERC granted the certificate on February 21, 2008 per a search summary not opened directly. No existing GEM row covers this line; the Tallgrass system row does not include it as far as the roster shows. The Federal Register notice does not state completion, so status rests on EIA only. Owner at present may differ since the parent system was sold in 2008; not checked. Route not researched; no official map found. Length is above the 25 km threshold.
